description: This file implements Wayland DMABUF interface functions, including resource creation, destruction, and binding, for handling buffer sharing in a Wayland compositor environment.

methods.name: buffer_destroy
methods.description: Handles destruction of a Wayland buffer resource.

methods.name: params_destroy_resource_callback
methods.description: Callback for resource destruction, currently a no-op.

methods.name: linux_buffer_params_add
methods.description: Adds buffer parameters such as file descriptor, plane, offset, stride, and modifiers.

methods.name: linux_buffer_params_create
methods.description: Creates a new buffer resource with specified width, height, format, and flags.

methods.name: linux_buffer_params_create_immed
methods.description: Creates a new buffer resource with an explicit ID, width, height, format, and flags.

methods.name: linux_dmabuf_destroy
methods.description: Handles destruction of a dmabuf resource.

methods.name: linux_dmabuf_create_params
methods.description: Creates buffer parameters for a dmabuf.

methods.name: bind_linux_dmabuf
methods.description: Binds the linux dmabuf interface to a Wayland display, setting up the global object.

methods.name: BindDmabufInterface
methods.description: Exports a function to bind the dmabuf interface to a Wayland display.
